title: ProblemFrame
description: Defines what agents are solving in a CCSR reasoning run.

id.description: Unique identifier for this problem frame.

run_id.description: Reference to the run this problem frame belongs to.

original_input.description: The original user input or query.

normalized_problem.description: A structured, normalized representation of the problem.

constraints.description: List of constraints that apply to this problem.

success_criteria.description: Criteria that must be met for the answer to be considered successful.

risk_level.description: Assessed risk level of the problem.

domain.description: Domain or subject area of the problem.

requires_business_decision.description: Whether this problem requires a business decision.

requires_research.description: Whether this problem requires research or evidence gathering.

requires_code.description: Whether this problem requires code generation or execution.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this problem frame was created.
